about: The exemplar corpus behind the grammar library (round 82d, Aug 3 2026). 19 files gathered from Instagram by the owner as 'perfect edits'; 16 unique videos (3 re-export duplicates). Each was measured by worker/tools/measure_reference.py and read frame-by-frame from contact sheets; grammars distill per-family rules.

universal_invariants.saturation: 0.004-0.088 across ALL 16 — every exemplar is heavily desaturated/muted with at most ONE accent color. Raw phone footage runs ~0.15-0.3; graded-down is the single most universal taste marker in the corpus.
universal_invariants.cuts_follow_speech_not_beats: no exemplar beat-locks meaningfully above its random baseline (best: 86% vs 64% chance). Typography, cuts and props sync to WORDS and story beats; music is a bed. 'Beat-align everything' is the wrong default for these genres.
universal_invariants.watermark: small creator handle persistent in a corner on nearly all
universal_invariants.ending: dark/dimmed final 1-3s with Instagram logo + handle, usually after a comment-keyword or follow CTA
universal_invariants.typography_is_the_energy: in talking-head families the cut rate is LOW (1-3 cuts/10s) and visual energy comes from type/graphics; in montage families the cut rate is HIGH (5-7 cuts/10s, ~1s median shots) and captions stay minimal
